outcome.Summary: Fixed three bugs in page/page.go's Get: (1) last page was missing its final item (`end = len(items)-1` off-by-one, now `len(items)`), (2) TotalPages over-counted when item count is an exact multiple of size (replaced `len/size + 1` with ceiling division `(len+size-1)/size`), and (3) requesting a page past the end panicked (now guarded by `start < len(items)`, returning an empty page). Also made Items a copy to honor the documented no-aliasing contract. Added regression tests to page/page_test.go covering the last page, exact multiples, past-the-end pages, empty input, aliasing, and argument validation; `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...` both pass.
